checked.claim: A Background held unsaved at the sheet's close, after another write of it, is not saved, and the notice asks for a field no longer on screen (minor)
checked.why: Traced again: the close hook calls saveBiography(app); a GM's write of the Background while the player types re-renders the player's sheet, tidyBiography keeps the held text and does not move its base (it sets _drpgBiographyBase only when nothing is held), so at the close held.base differs from the stored text and the save returns null after the warning. No caller saves after the close (callers: the focusout, the tab's click, the close). The tests do not pin the opposite: E24-T2 (ok, shard 7/8 - the reader thought it had not run) drives a close with no other write of the Background and a GM's Hope write only; scenario 71 I drives the conflict with the sheet open and saves by a tab click. Minor holds: the text waits on the app object and comes back on a reopen of the same sheet in the same page.
